PIN NUMBER RECEIVED!!! Liverpool, my bestfriend is finally coming!!! 🎉🎉🎉 @Lorna Villaruz I have been trying to type this properly but I am too happy hahaha. Today your NMC PIN came through and now I can say it, officially a registered nurse in the UK!! Thank you Lord!!! 🙏❤️

From our nursing school days in Iloilo, our capping ceremony in 1996, to this. Look at us, Lorna!! Same friendship, just more grey hairs which we will not discuss 😂 I still remember us in the dorm polishing our white shoes every single night. And when I say OUR polish, really it was MY polish because this woman never bought her own!! Always borrowing mine. You can bring your own this time ha, I have not forgotten after 30 years 😂😂

When I left for the UK in 2004 you cried at the airport and told me “susunod ako,” I will follow you. Well, 22 years later!!! You did not say you were taking the scenic route through Riyadh and Dubai hahaha. Almost 18 years working out there, and all this time me saying come to Liverpool, come to Liverpool. You must be so tired of hearing it. Now finally I can change my speech to HAVE YOU PACKED YOUR COAT??

She lands in Manchester on 14 January 2027 and starts work on 25 January, so January cannot come quick enough!! Ward 7, you are very lucky. You are getting the best nurse I know. I am not just saying that because she is my bestfriend and knows all my nursing school secrets. She is so calm, so kind, and the patients love her. That is our Lorna. I am so proud of you, dai. All those papers, exams and waiting, and now this lovely news ❤️

When you went to Nottingham for your OSCE I sent you a photo of the rain, remember? Just so nobody can say Rosario did not warn me 😂 Please bring a PROPER coat. Not a little jacket that looks nice in the airport photo. Liverpool wind does not care about your outfit!! We will get you wrapped up properly.

Your spare room is waiting for you for that first month, and yes, Ben says okay!! Thick duvet ready because I already know you will be freezing. You said dried mangoes and Bicol pili for Tito Ben, so now he will be checking your luggage before you have even sat down hahaha. Imagine, after all these years we will be having a cup of tea in the same kitchen instead of sending messages across the world.

And to our Filipino family here, please help me give Lorna the biggest welcome!! There will be plenty of introductions, plenty of food, and you know nobody escapes the Christmas parties 😂 Next year you will be with us for those, and Simbang Gabi too. No more me telling you about everything afterwards, you will actually be here beside us.

Congratulations my sister from another mother!!! From those white shoes in Iloilo to nursing here in the UK. I am smiling like a fool just writing this. Liverpool is waiting for you, and so are we!! Love you, see you in January!!! ❤️🎉🙏
